general.colossalchests2.description: Chests that are quite colossal, and can be upgraded.
block.colossalchests2.chest_wall_wood.in: Build a hollow cube of walls of one material, with one core of that material in it, to form a chest.
block.colossalchests2.chest_core_wood.in: Holds the contents. Replace one wall of a hollow cube with it to form a chest. Keeps contents and upgrades when broken.

block.colossalchests2.chest_wall_interfa: A wall for chest external access. Sneak-right-click with empty hand to set filters.
block.colossalchests2.chest_wall_void.in: An interface that destroys overflowing items.
Pulls dropped items around it into the chest. Sneak-right-click with empty hand to set its radius.
block.colossalchests2.chest_wall_redston: Emits a redstone signal based on how full the chest is.
block.colossalchests2.chest_wall_display: Shows an item and its count. Take items with (sneak-)left-click and insert with (double) right-click.

block.colossalchests2.uncolossal_chest.i: A tiny chest with five slots. The most colossal of 'em all!
item.colossalchests2.upgrade_depth.info: Multiplies the stacks per slot. Chest material determines limit.
item.colossalchests2.upgrade_lock.info: Lets slots be locked to an item type. Alt-click a slot to toggle, or right-click an empty slot with an item to reserve it.
item.colossalchests2.upgrade_bundling.in: Lets each slot hold more unstackable items, such as tools.
item.colossalchests2.upgrade_void.info: Lets slots be marked as voiding. Alt-right-click a slot to toggle. Automation inserting into a full voiding slot destroys the overflow.
item.colossalchests2.material_upgrade_to: Right click on a formed chest to swap to a different material. Right click in air to select material.
gui.colossalchests2.material_upgrade_too: Use on a formed chest to apply.
item.colossalchests2.upgrade_compression: Combines the forms of an item, such as nuggets, ingots and blocks, in one slot.
gui.colossalchests2.upgrade.better_mater: A chest of a better material takes more
gui.colossalchests2.upgrade.no_free_slot: This chest has no free upgrade slot
gui.colossalchests2.upgrade.removal_refu: Can't remove: %s slots would not fit without it
Can't remove: 1 slot would not fit without it
gui.colossalchests2.redstone.whole_chest: Redstone signal is based on the overall chest contents. Click with an item to consider only the slots holding this item.
gui.colossalchests2.wall.displayed.info: Click with item to choose, click with empty hand to clear.
gui.colossalchests2.display.shown_option: If this side should have a display box.
gui.colossalchests2.display.count.info: If this side shows how many of this item is contained in the chest.
gui.colossalchests2.display.fill_level.i: If this side shows how full the slots holding this item are.
gui.colossalchests2.display.upgrade_indi: If this side should show the Lock, Void and Compression upgrade icons for this item.
gui.colossalchests2.wall.mode.both.info: Items can be inserted and extracted.
gui.colossalchests2.slot_voiding: Voiding: overflow from automation is destroyed. Alt-right-click to stop.
gui.colossalchests2.void_all.info: Mark every slot that holds items as voiding.
gui.colossalchests2.slot_locked: Locked: only takes this item. Alt-click to unlock.
gui.colossalchests2.lock_all.info: Lock every slot that holds items.
gui.colossalchests2.clear_locks.info: Unlock all slots. Contents are not modified.
gui.colossalchests2.over_capacity: %s slots are over capacity: take items out until they fit
gui.colossalchests2.slot_over_capacity: Over capacity: take items out until it fits again.
chest.colossalchests2.material_change.no: No material has been selected yet. Right click in the air.
Chest is not fully formed yet.
chest.colossalchests2.material_change.to: %s chests can be at most %s blocks wide.
chest.colossalchests2.material_change.up: %s chests have %s upgrade slots. Remove upgrades first.
%s chests take fewer of an installed upgrade. Remove upgrades first.
chest.colossalchests2.over_capacity: Over capacity slots: %s. They hold more than they can, so they are extract-only. This happens after re-forming a chest or lowering capacity settings.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.none: This chest has no problems, it should form shortly.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.no_core: Not formed: no chest core. Replace one wall with a core of the same material.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.multiple: Not formed: a chest needs exactly one core, found %s (highlighted).
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.not_cube: Not formed: the walls span %sx%sx%s, but a chest must be a cube.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.too_smal: Not formed: a chest must be at least 2x2x2.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.too_larg: Not formed: %s blocks wide, but this material allows at most %s.
chest.colossalchests2.diagnosis.blocks: Not formed. Missing walls: %s, other material: %s, blocks inside: %s (highlighted).
